usage: agentware fleet [-h] [--format {text,json}] {issues,impact} ...

positional arguments:
  {issues,impact}
    issues              top recurring failure outcomes + top learning tags
                        across teams
    impact              causal before/after failure-rate delta at a steering-
                        sha|date t0

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
